title: 10 月手游畅销榜：Honor of Kings、Roblox、Monopoly Go、Gossip Harbor 等
content:
October’s top grossing mobile game chart: Honor of Kings, Roblox, Monopoly Go, Gossip Harbor, more – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Here are last month’s top grossing mobile games based on in-app purchase earnings, according to
Appmagic
data.
These IAP estimates do not include ad revenue, web shop spend, Apple and Google’s 30% cut or revenue from China’s Android ecosystem.
There’s commentary on which way the biggest earners are trending, and other interesting tidbits from the top 20 and beyond below.
In between these monthly updates, you can keep tabs on
Appmagic’s top grossing and top downloads charts anytime here
.
And you can find our look at
October’s top download chart here
.

These top grossing games may not be jostling for position very much on the surface, but there are plenty of microdramas in these listings once you look closer.
For example:
Honor of Kings
revenue steadier than it has been for a while. Its monthly IAP earnings were yo-yo-ing all over the place between August 2025 and July 2026, but Tencent’s MOBA has now posted in the $103-104m range two months running.
Roblox
IAP earnings ticked up a little bit on last month but are still down on July and August’s totals, in which it cleared $100m both months. (And as ever, October’s total is nowhere near the wild high of July 2025 when it hit $144m.)
Monopoly Go
’s IAP earnings slid for a third month running, but generally have been around the $75m range since February 2026.
Gossip Harbor
’s run up the top grossing charts has cooled off a bit after peaking in August, when it hit $78m. After dipping slightly under $70m in September, October’s total netted out in between those two points at $74m.
Match 3 contenders Royal Match and Candy Crush Saga have both been declining by IAP revenue recently, and they swapped places in October.
Royal Match
halted a steady overall decline that started in early 2025, when it was regularly earning over $100m per month. October’s total of $62.8m is way down on even a year ago, and might(?) have something to do with the continued rise of Royal Kingdom or perhaps a low-key webshop launch (if you know what’s going on here,
email us
).
Candy Crush Saga
’s revenue graph is much steadier, though October’s haul of $56m was its lowest since February 2021.
Century Games’
Whiteout Survival
has seen a pretty sudden drop too – October is its second month earning around $52-53m, having previously been in the $75-85m bracket for most of 2026.
Century’s other top ten regular,
Kingshot
, is also flat month-on-month and appears to be in gentle decline. It has dipped under $50m again for the first time since it was being aggressively scaled up in mid-2025.
Coin Master
’s return to the top ten is more to do with Pokémon Go and Delta Force falling away than any sudden surge, as it posted about $37m for the second month. Overall, though, the game has been declining ever since the end of 2024.
It’s the same deal with
Township
– it was up a little month-on-month to ~$30m but its reemergence in the top ten is more to do with others dropping out. In fact, Playrix’s farming game is down on the $33-36m it was raking in over the summer.

Playrix’s
Gardenscapes
posted about $29m in IAP revenue for its second month running, which meant it rose up the rankings as some other big titles dropped off.
In that same $28m-ish bracket,
Royal Kingdom
leapt up a few spots too, a fairly typical month for Dream’s other big match 3 puzzler.
Free Fire Max
’s IAP income dropped a little bit but still managed to move up three spots as
Pokémon Go, Delta Force, eFootball
and
PUBG Mobile
all declined month-on-month.
Scopely Explore’s Pokémon Go saw perhaps the most dramatic drop – down from about $52m in September to ~$24m last month, though the game is generally quite spiky due to its events calendar.
Century Games’ now has three games in the top 20 with the addition of
Tasty Travels
– it has been scaling pretty nicely since early 2025 and looks very much like an up-and-coming contender to Gossip Harbor in the merge puzzle category.
Outside the top 20 there were notable IAP revenue spikes for
Wuthering Waves
(up 27 places to 25th spot with $15m) and
Pokémon TCG Pocket
(up 24 places to 27th spot with $14m).
